verdict.rationale: Requesty has a dedicated streaming feature page that documents token-by-token delivery of content as it is generated through its OpenAI-compatible router. Multi-provider breadth is implied by the unified 300+/600+ model API, but the docs do not explicitly confirm streaming works for every provider. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that streaming works across all providers, protocol details (SSE format, usage chunks), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream token-by-token responses through the gateway from any provider

citations.quote: Streaming responses provide immediate feedback to users by delivering content token-by-token as it's generated
